# Sameko Dev C++

> Sameko Dev C++ is a free, open-source (MIT) C++ IDE for Windows and Linux, built on Electron and the Monaco editor. On Windows it bundles GCC 16.1.0 (MinGW), clangd and GDB, so you can write, compile, run and debug C++ without installing a compiler. The Linux AppImage uses the g++, gdb and clangd installed on the system. Current version: 1.4.0 (released 2026-11-07).

It is aimed at beginners, students and competitive programmers. Key facts:

- C++98 through C++26 (C++17 by default), chosen in Settings → Compiler.
- Live diagnostics from clangd (about 100–130 ms), with g++ -fsyntax-only as fallback.
- GDB debugger with breakpoints, variables and call stack.
- Test cases with Output / Expected cards, parallel "Run All Tests", real wall time and peak memory.
- Competitive Companion integration to import problems and tests from online judges.
- Markdown preview, AStyle formatting with format on save, and plain-text support for test files (.txt, .inp, .out, .ans).
- Snippets, checkpoints (local history), and a Theme Customizer with background images or video.
- Two Windows downloads: an installer (.exe, auto-updates) and a portable zip that runs from a USB drive without admin rights.
- Interface in English, Tiếng Việt and 简体中文; optional Vim Mode.
- No ads, no account, no telemetry.
- Official downloads are only on sameko.dev and github.com/QuangquyNguyenvo/Sameko-Dev-CPP/releases; forks of the repository are not official builds.
- Not the same program as Dev-C++ (Bloodshed / Orwell / Embarcadero): Sameko Dev C++ is an independent, newer IDE and a modern alternative to it, not a fork.
- Named after the VTuber Sameko Saba as an unofficial fan project; it is not affiliated with her.

## Docs

- [Sameko Dev C++ vs Dev-C++](https://sameko.dev/dev-cpp-alternative): how it differs from Dev-C++ (compiler, standards, shortcuts, platforms), a feature comparison with Code::Blocks, VS Code and CLion, and how to move over
- [Trang chủ tiếng Việt](https://sameko.dev/vi) and [So sánh với Dev-C++](https://sameko.dev/thay-the-dev-cpp): Vietnamese versions of the home page and the comparison
- [Wiki (English)](https://sameko.dev/wiki): installation, first project, requirements, compiler settings, shortcuts, themes, debugger, snippets, Competitive Companion, troubleshooting
- [Wiki (Tiếng Việt)](https://sameko.dev/wiki-vi): Vietnamese version of the wiki
- [Release notes](https://sameko.dev/wiki#whats-new): what changed in 1.4.0, 1.3.2 and 1.3.1
- [Troubleshooting](https://sameko.dev/wiki#troubleshooting): IDE won't open, missing DLL, compile errors, Windows Defender false positives

## Download

- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/QuangquyNguyenvo/Sameko-Dev-CPP/releases): Windows installer, Windows portable zip and Linux AppImage
